505897.name: Bzince pod Javorinou
505897.note: Bzince pod Javorinou's elections documents (obecbzince.sk/dokumenty/volby/, all categories) start in 2022; for this vote there is no okrsky document (for the presidential election 2024 only the delegation address). The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

508527.name: Čierny Balog
508527.note: The archived by-election page (doplňujúce voľby v obvode č. 3, 13 Apr 2019) gives the candidates, an information PDF for voters and the result, but no utvorenie volebných okrskov; no other document of the by-election found.

513156.name: Ilava
513156.note: The by-election page 'Voľby na poslanca za mestskú časť Iliavka dňa 13. apríla 2019' (aktualita of 15.01.2019) and its PDF akt_iliavka-poslanec.pdf were never captured before the vote (PDF 404 in 2024); nothing on the live site.

514209.name: Nedožery-Brezany
514209.note: No document assigning streets or parts to the two okrsky found. The municipality's okrsky decisions on nedozery-brezany.sk (2023: images/Vytvorenie_volebnch_okrskov_a_urenie_volebnch_miestnost2023.pdf; 2026: images/Urenie_volebnch_okrskov_a_volebnej_miestnosti.pdf) only create two okrsky with both polling stations in the municipal office (Družstevná 367/1), so neither the streets nor the parts (Nedožery, Brezany) of each okrsok can be read or inferred; for the other votes the site and the Internet Archive's index of nedozery-brezany.sk hold no okrsky notice.

517097.name: Nová Baňa
517097.note: No okrsky document of the by-election of 13 April 2019 is on the website; Internet Archive offline.

521876.name: Perín-Chym
521876.note: The archived page of the 13 April 2019 by-election holds only voter information; images 'komunálne voľby 2019' and 'OZNAM volby 2019' may be its notices. The municipality's host refused all connections from here for over 50 minutes (after a few requests), so these could not be read; the Internet Archive has no capture of the full-size images.

526291.name: Stratená
526291.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..360) and the election pages were checked: the only okrsky/obvody document is that of the elections of 2022 (obsah160_2); for this vote there is none. web.archive.org was unreachable (connection refused) when checked.

542938.name: Horné Obdokovce
542938.note: The live page 'Komunálne voľby 2019' (by-elections of 13 April 2019) lists the announcement, information for voters, the population count, the number of obvody and councillors, the MVK recorder notice and the registered candidates; no okrsky document. The only okrsky document the website has (live and archived) is the mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of the elections of 29 October 2022 (download_file_f.php?id=1734793, posted 4.8.2022: okrsok 1 Bodok and Horné Obdokovce, okrsok 2 Obsolovce), which is another vote's document. The Internet Archive answered only intermittently (often 'Temporarily Offline' or connection refused) but its CDX lists were obtained; it holds no okrsky document of this vote. The live host rate-limited (HTTP 429) part of the time.
